blocks.text: Dawaiyan banane mein chirality hifazat aur asar ke liye nihayat ahem hai. Jaandaar nizam chiral ajza se bane hain, aur dawa ke receptors bohat makhsoos chiral taalon ki tarah kaam karte hain, is liye chiral dawa ke do enantiomers ke asraat aksar bohat mukhtalif hote hain. Is liye dawa sazon ko ya to racemic mixtures ko alag isomers mein juda karna hota hai ya aise chiral catalysts use karne hote hain jo aik hi khalis optical isomer banayein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dashed bond ke daen sire wala ring carbon chiral hai: is par H, N aur halqe ke do mukhtalif carbon (aik C=O ki taraf, aik CH2 ki taraf) jure hain. Is liye thalidomide ke do enantiomers hain. Dawa racemic mixture ki shakal mein bechi gayi thi, aur jism mein khaalis (+) isomer bhi jaldi racemic ho jata hai.

Thalidomide pehle racemic mixture ki shakal mein becha gaya aur bohat kamyab, ghair zehreeli sukoon aawar (tranquilliser) dawa lagi jis ke koi maloom muzir asraat na the. Lekin 1960 ki dahai ke shuru mein pata chala ke jin auraton ko hamal ke ibtidai dinon mein matli ('morning sickness') ke liye yeh di gayi un ke bachche shadeed jismani naqais ke saath paida hue, aur dawa fauran wapas le li gayi. Tehqeeq ne dikhaya ke (+) isomer mo'assar aur mehfooz tranquilliser tha jab ke (-) isomer janeen (fetus) ko nuqsan pohanchata tha. Pehle masla kuch batches mein (-) isomer ki milawat samjha gaya, lekin baad ki tehqeeq ne dikhaya ke khalis (+) isomer khoon mein tezi se racemise hota hai: 10 minute mein racemisation 50% se zyada mukammal ho jati hai. Baad mein thalidomide sakht pabandiyon ke saath dobara market kiya gaya, aur chirality mein mustahkam milti julti dawaiyan sozish (inflammation) dur karne wali dawa ke taur par parhi ja rahi hain.

blocks.title: Thalidomide aaj
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke thalidomide dobara kabhi market nahi hoga, aur chirality mein mustahkam milti julti dawaiyan sozish dur karne wali dawa ke taur par parhi ja rahi hain. Darasal thalidomide ko baad mein sakht pabandiyon ke saath, jo hamal mein is ka istemal rokti hain, kuch bimariyon, jaise leprosy ki aik pecheedgi aur khoon ke cancer multiple myeloma, ke liye dobara manzoor kiya gaya.

blocks.prompt: Thalidomide ka sirf mehfooz (+) isomer bechna kyun kaafi nahi tha?
blocks.explanation: (+) isomer khoon mein jaldi racemise hota hai (10 minute mein 50% se zyada), is liye nuqsan deh (-) isomer jism mein phir bhi ban jata hai.

items: Receptors chiral hain, is liye dawa ke enantiomers bohat mukhtalif asar kar sakte.
Racemic mixtures juda karne parte, ya chiral catalysts aik isomer bana sakte.
Thalidomide: (-) isomer ne janeen ko nuqsan diya; (+) isomer jism mein racemise hota.
